finance.name: Valuation
finance.blurb: What a business is worth: the cost of capital, then its cash flows discounted at that rate.

finance.name: Investment decisions
finance.blurb: Which projects to fund, compared on NPV, IRR, MIRR, payback and profitability index.
tools: Capital budgeting for up to three projects

finance.name: Stock analysis
finance.blurb: Return, risk and beta for a share against the market, and the portfolio mix with the best return for its risk.
tools: Beta and alpha by CAPM regression

finance.name: Risk management
finance.blurb: How much a portfolio could lose on a bad day, whether the model has been right, and how a company’s credit looks.
tools: Value at Risk and Expected Shortfall

finance.name: Bonds and options
finance.blurb: Bond prices, yields, duration and convexity; option values, Greeks and implied volatility.

analytics.name: Explore your data
analytics.blurb: Bring a table: a quality check, descriptive statistics, correlations, and regression with its diagnostics.

analytics.name: Supervised learning
analytics.blurb: Predict a yes-or-no outcome, comparing logistic regression, a decision tree, nearest neighbours and a random forest fairly.

analytics.name: Unsupervised learning
analytics.blurb: Find structure without labels: groups of similar rows and the few directions that explain most of the variation.

analytics.name: Forecasting
analytics.blurb: Carry a seasonal series forward with a range, after checking the method on a season it never saw.

marketing.name: Market segmentation
marketing.blurb: Split a market into groups that want different things, size them, and decide which to target.

marketing.name: Market map
marketing.blurb: Compare countries on a world map and rank where to expand, with your own weights.

marketing.name: Pricing
marketing.blurb: How much units fall when price rises, and the price that earns the most.

marketing.name: Growth and experiments
marketing.blurb: Whether customers are worth what they cost to win, and whether a test result is real.

learn.name: Lessons
learn.blurb: One short lesson for each skill: the idea, the formula, a worked example, a calculator and three questions.
